verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is a SaaS mailbox service, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The only programmatic touchpoints are a Zapier integration and a general API, which are developer building blocks rather than an MCP server. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
